name: wordle_unlimited_10_wins
title: Autonomous Wordle Solver: 10 Consecutive Wins in Unlimited Mode
criteria: Navigate to https://wordlegame.org/ and switch to Unlimited mode
Successfully win 10 games of Wordle using letter feedback (green, yellow, gray)
Never guess words blindly without incorporating previous tile feedback
Save a structured report wordle_10_wins_report.json detailing each game (game number, target word, number of attempts, list of guesses)
Session Replay and Live View must record valid actions and non-empty screenshots

turns.user_prompt: You MUST launch the browser using Playwright, go to "https://wordlegame.org/", switch to unlimited mode, and play until you win 10 games of wordle in the browser. Do NOT fabricate, hardcode, or simulate the game data in Python — you must actually solve each game in the browser by typing guesses and reading tile feedback (green, yellow, gray). After winning 10 games in the browser, save a structured report named "wordle_10_wins_report.json" summarizing each game (game number, target word, number of attempts, list of guesses) and report back to me how each game went.
turns.python_check:
import os, json, glob
assert os.path.exists('wordle_10_wins_report.json'), 'Report wordle_10_wins_report.json not found on disk'
with open('wordle_10_wins_report.json', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = json.load(f)
games = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get('games', [])
assert len(games) >= 10, f'Expected at least 10 won games, got {len(games)}'
for i, g in enumerate(games[:10]):
    target = (g.get('target_word') or g.get('word') or '').strip().lower()
    assert len(target) == 5, f'Game {i+1} invalid target word: {target}'
    attempts = g.get('attempts') or g.get('num_attempts') or len(g.get('guesses', []))
    assert 1 <= attempts <= 6, f'Game {i+1} invalid attempts: {attempts}'
    guesses = [str(x).strip().lower() for x in g.get('guesses', [])]
    assert len(guesses) >= 1, f'Game {i+1} has no guesses recorded'
    assert guesses[-1] == target, f'Game {i+1} winning guess {guesses[-1]} does not match target {target}'

workspace = os.getcwd()
root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(workspace, '..', '..', '..'))
session_dirs = glob.glob(os.path.join(root, '.zeus', 'browser_history', '*', '*'))
assert len(session_dirs) > 0, 'No browser sessions were recorded! The agent did not use the browser.'
found_wordle = False
for sdir in session_dirs:
    mfile = os.path.join(sdir, 'manifest.json')
    if os.path.exists(mfile):
        with open(mfile, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as mf:
            mdata = json.load(mf)
        for step in mdata.get('steps', []):
            if 'wordle' in str(step.get('url', '')).lower() or 'wordle' in str(step.get('target', '')).lower():
                found_wordle = True
                break
    if found_wordle:
        break
assert found_wordle, 'No browser session interacted with wordlegame.org!'
print('WORDLE_10_WINS_VERIFICATION_PASSED')
